title: Film Thickness Measurement - Stacking Faults Detection on ATL/LMS IPRO8
subtitle: Post-Planarization Quality Validation for 3nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Yuki Tanaka

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system to detect and classify Stacking Faults defects during post-planarization inspection at the 3nm technology node. The test is conducted at Dresden Fab 3 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Stacking Faults defects that are critical to yield at the 3nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the ATL/LMS IPRO8 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: ATL/LMS IPRO8
- Inspection Type: Film Thickness Measurement
- Target Defect: Stacking Faults
- Process Step: Post-Planarization
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 3nm
- Fab Location: Dresden Fab 3

This test case applies to all ATL/LMS IPRO8 systems deployed at Dresden Fab 3 for post-planarization monitoring in the 3nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: ATL/LMS IPRO8
Software Version: v11.2.567
Recipe: FILM_THICKNESS_MEASUREMENT_3nm_POST_PLANARIZATION
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: High (87 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 1.0μm
Edge Exclusion: 2mm
Sampling Plan: 9-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Film Thickness Measurement' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Stacking Faults defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 3nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 69 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 97% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.9% for Film Thickness Measurement
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.96 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-04-09
Wafers Tested: 41
Total Defects Found: 33
Defect Density: 10.5 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 7.2%
Capture Rate: 97.3%
Test Duration: 375 minutes
System Uptime: 96.0%

Result Classification: CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The ATL/LMS IPRO8 demonstrated acceptable performance in detecting Stacking Faults at the 3nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate exceeds the target threshold; recipe tuning is recommended.

d) Edge-zone defect detection showed improved performance compared to previous revision.

e) SECS/GEM communication was verified with zero packet loss during data transfer.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
